# Orrery — inspiration only

Software studios. Motion personality: cinematic 3D. One WebGL stage, parallax camera, CSS depth on controls. No split-flap, no confetti, no goo.

## Look at

- Oryzo AI, Lusion, Awwwards SOTD 13 April 2026. WebGL sketches, a 3D-to-2D transition, palette of `#100904` and `#FF8539`. We take “one warm rim on a dark ground,” not their sketches. https://www.awwwards.com/sites/oryzo-ai
- Minh Pham portfolio, June 2026 write-up. Three.js used so imagery stays intact, motion is one system. https://www.hontran.dev/blog/minh-pham-portfolio-case-study
- Svilenković, mid-2026. SOTD 3D wins by restraint, scroll narrative, and reduced motion. Generic particles lose. https://svilenkovic.com/3d/awwwards-2026-3d
- GQ × Audemars Piguet, Extraordinary Lab. Cinematic WebGL as a timeline. Ours is a small orrery, not a campaign film. https://www.awwwards.com/gq-audemars-piguet-the-extraordinary-lab.html
- Spline’s 2026 product-stage pattern (Framer trends note). A single object, not an 8MB scene. https://framerwebsites.com/blog/ui-design-trends-2026

## We will write

Obsidian and a molten gold rim. A tiny React Three Fiber scene: rings, a capped pixel ratio, frameloop only while the motion setting is rich. Buttons tilt in CSS `rotateX`. The modal approaches like a camera move (scale and opacity).

## We will not write

Their models, a Linear purple glow, or a particle galaxy.
